arguments.message: By default, the response‑time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered – that includes nights, weekends and holidays. If you want to exclude those periods, you can set up business hours in Settings → Reporting → Business hours and switch the dashboard to the “business hours” mode. That version will ignore time outside the configured hours entirely. You can also show both versions side‑by‑side on a custom dashboard for comparison.
